description: All current Bank of Israel representative exchange rates vs the Israeli Shekel (ILS). Returns one entry per currency with currentExchangeRate (shekels per `unit` of the foreign currency), currentChange (% vs previous), unit (1 for most, 100 for some like JPY — per-1 rate = currentExchangeRate / unit), and lastUpdate. Use this for a snapshot of all available currencies.
name: boi_exchange_rates
title: Boi Exchange Rates
